frontierDefinition: A control-by-control envelope formed from the strongest relevant public Microsoft, Alphabet/Google, SoftBank and standards-owner practices. It is not a vendor ranking and does not infer non-public internal capabilities.

controls.title: Role-specialist multi-agent planning and handoffs
controls.rationale: Frontier systems coordinate bounded specialists through explicit handoffs and terminal states.

controls.title: Managed runtime, sessions and durable memory
controls.rationale: Long-running agent work needs managed execution, session identity and recoverable state.

controls.title: Governed tool registry and effect boundaries
controls.rationale: Every agent tool needs explicit identity, permissions, schemas and effect classification.

controls.title: Model and provider portability with controlled fallback
controls.rationale: A frontier control plane can change models without weakening policy, evidence or safety gates.

controls.title: Persistent memory with scoped retrieval
controls.rationale: Memory must persist, remain scoped to its subject and be independently recoverable.

controls.title: Enterprise knowledge grounding and connector governance
controls.rationale: Grounding needs source identity, access enforcement, traceability and freshness.

controls.title: Versioned provenance and citation lineage
controls.rationale: Outputs must resolve to exact source versions and preserve the path from evidence to claim.

controls.title: Cross-session checkpoint, replay and restoration
controls.rationale: Long workstreams need deterministic checkpoint restoration, not conversational memory claims.

controls.title: Least privilege, workload identity and explicit authorization
controls.rationale: Every runtime and effect route must have a bounded identity and deny by default.

controls.title: Per-agent and per-tool identity with delegated scopes
controls.rationale: Shared ambient credentials prevent attribution and safe least-privilege delegation.

controls.title: Private networking, isolation and data perimeter
controls.rationale: Production agent systems require private connectivity and controlled data movement.

controls.title: Prompt-injection, data-exfiltration and unsafe-tool defenses
controls.rationale: Agent-specific threats need layered input, tool, data and output controls plus adversarial proof.

controls.title: Govern, map, measure and manage AI risk
controls.rationale: AI risk must be a continuous operating process rather than a one-time checklist.

controls.title: Threat modeling and misuse-case analysis
controls.rationale: Threats and misuse cases must be modeled before deployment and revisited after material change.

controls.title: Evaluation, red-team and adversarial quality gates
controls.rationale: Functional tests alone cannot prove model quality, robustness or safe tool use.

controls.title: Human oversight, override and escalation
controls.rationale: High-impact actions need visible ownership, reversible control and fail-closed escalation.

controls.title: End-to-end distributed tracing and lineage
controls.rationale: Agent, model, tool and connector spans must be correlated across a complete request.

controls.title: Continuous quality, safety and groundedness evaluation
controls.rationale: Quality regressions need automated datasets, evaluators, thresholds and release gates.

controls.title: Runtime latency, error, saturation and availability metrics
controls.rationale: Operational health requires measurable service indicators, not test completion.

controls.title: Token, model, tool and unit-cost telemetry
controls.rationale: Cost and capacity decisions require per-workflow resource attribution.

controls.title: Service-level objectives and error budgets
controls.rationale: Reliability targets must govern release velocity and recovery work.

controls.title: Fault isolation, backpressure and circuit breaking
controls.rationale: A failed model, connector or agent must not cascade across the system.

controls.title: Backup, disaster recovery and proven restoration
controls.rationale: Backups count only when exact state can be restored within declared objectives.

controls.title: Incident response, postmortems and release freeze policy
controls.rationale: Operational learning needs terminal incident records, owners and verified corrective action.

controls.title: Golden paths and repeatable environment templates
controls.rationale: Standardized paved roads reduce drift while preserving explicit exceptions.

controls.title: Self-service provisioning with guardrails
controls.rationale: Teams should obtain compliant environments without bypassing central security.

controls.title: Platform policy, tenancy and lifecycle governance
controls.rationale: Platform ownership must cover tenancy, upgrades, deprecation and exception handling.

controls.title: Adoption, developer experience and feedback measurement
controls.rationale: A platform succeeds only when internal users adopt it and feedback changes priorities.

controls.title: Protected source changes and independent review
controls.rationale: Every production source change needs traceable review and protected history.

controls.title: Automated tests, evaluation gates and exact-head CI
controls.rationale: Release evidence must bind to the exact candidate source identity.

controls.title: DORA delivery and stability performance measurement
controls.rationale: Deployment frequency, lead time, failure rate and recovery need trendable measurement.

controls.title: Environment promotion, canary and rollback policy
controls.rationale: Deployments need separated environments, bounded exposure, semantic proof and reversible promotion.

controls.title: Immutable dependencies, actions and build inputs
controls.rationale: Mutable dependencies prevent reproducibility and enable silent compromise.

controls.title: Signed provenance and artifact attestations
controls.rationale: A deployable artifact must trace back to an approved source and trusted builder.

controls.title: SBOM, vulnerability and dependency-risk management
controls.rationale: Known components and vulnerabilities need continuous discovery, ownership and remediation.

controls.title: Policy admission before deployment
controls.rationale: Only artifacts satisfying identity, provenance, test and policy gates should execute.

controls.title: Globally transactional effect and recovery state
controls.rationale: Effects, nonces and recovery state must survive concurrency and regional failure.

controls.title: Tamper-evident ledger and external immutable anchor
controls.rationale: Local hash chains need a provider-managed high-water anchor to resist total local deletion or replay.

controls.title: Versioned schemas, migrations and compatibility
controls.rationale: State evolution needs tested forward/backward compatibility and rollback.

controls.title: Retention, privacy, residency and deletion controls
controls.rationale: Knowledge and telemetry must observe purpose, minimization, residency and lifecycle requirements.

controls.title: Exact provider and model binding with semantic readback
controls.rationale: Configuration or payload construction is not provider proof; the exact runtime must answer bounded canaries.

controls.title: Managed deployment, private IAM and runtime lineage
controls.rationale: A production service needs immutable source-to-image-to-revision lineage and verified denial boundaries.

controls.title: External secret storage, signing and key rotation
controls.rationale: Production credentials and permit signing cannot live in source or local process state.

controls.title: Traffic management, rollback and dynamic resource control
controls.rationale: Traffic, capacity and rollback need continuously evaluated desired state and verified outcomes.

controls.title: Budgets, quotas and hard cost caps
controls.rationale: Autonomous systems need explicit spend ceilings and fail-closed overrun behavior.

controls.title: Dynamic resource and workload optimization
controls.rationale: Capacity should follow measured demand, service objectives and marginal value.

controls.title: Per-capability unit economics and value measurement
controls.rationale: Roadmap decisions need cost per useful outcome and measured value, not only total spend.

controls.title: Energy and sustainability-aware architecture
controls.rationale: Frontier architecture includes energy, carbon and resource-efficiency tradeoffs.

controls.title: Cross-functional product, platform, security, SRE and AI ownership
controls.rationale: Complex agent platforms require explicit ownership across technical and risk disciplines.

controls.title: Documentation, training and reusable engineering competencies
controls.rationale: Practices become capabilities only when documented, taught, reused and behaviorally proven.

controls.title: Failure learning, postmortems and verified corrective action
controls.rationale: Failure records must produce owned, testable improvements and later canary evidence.

controls.title: Continuous external benchmark and roadmap feedback loop
controls.rationale: The benchmark corpus must refresh, detect change, preserve provenance and produce review-gated roadmap deltas.
